integrity: Analytic proof in RESULT.md; auxiliary exact-rational finite checks in verify.py do not constitute universal proof. No claim to external certification or publication.
scientific_limitations: Equal-size complete multipartite graphs with \(r\ge3\) parts, \(p\ge2\) vertices per part, and unit edge lengths only; exact norms for \(q=1,2,\infty\), optimality without closed constants for other real \(q\). Independent external proof and bibliographic review have not been performed.
title: Simultaneously minimal cycle and cut projections for balanced complete multipartite graphs
